mapper.select: SELECT A.ADDRESS_ID AS addressId, A.ADDRESS_ALIAS AS addressAlias, A.ZIPCODE AS zipcode, A.ADDRESS AS address, A.DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress, A.DEFAULT_YN AS defaultYn, U.USER_NAME AS receiverName, U.USER_PHONE AS receiverPhone FROM USER_ADDRESS A INNER JOIN `USER` U ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE A.DEFAULT_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, A.ADDRESS_ID DESC

select.if: SELECT c.cart_id AS cartId, c.quantity AS quantity, c.cart_type AS cartType, c.user_id AS userId, c.product_id AS productId, c.option_id AS optionId, c.rental_start AS rentalStart, c.rental_end AS rentalEnd, p.product_name AS productName, p.price AS price, b.brand_name AS brandName, o.option_value AS optionName, ( SELECT img_url FROM PRODUCT_IMG WHERE product_id = c.product_id AND is_main = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ) AS imgUrl FROM CART c INNER JOIN PRODUCT p ON c.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION o ON c.option_id = o.option_id WHERE c.cart_id IN (${cartIds}) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( ORDER_ID, AMOUNT, PAY_STATUS, PAID_AT ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{amount}, 'PAID', NOW() )

INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEM ( ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, OPTION_ID, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, START_DATE, END_DATE, OPTION_ID ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{optionId}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{rentalStart}, #{rentalEnd}, NULLIF(#{optionId}, '') )
mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.USER_ID, O.CART_IDS, O.USER_COUPON_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.GUEST_NAME, O.GUEST_PHONE, ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID LIMIT 1 ) AS orderName, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID ) AS itemCount FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_COUPON SET USED_YN = 'Y', USED_AT = NOW(), ORDER_ID = #{orderId}, STATUS = 'USED', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_COUPON_ID = #{userCouponId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'AVAILABLE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COUPON_USE_LOG ( USER_COUPON_ID, USER_ID, COUPON_ID, ORDER_ID, USED_AT, DISCOUNT_APPLIED_AMT ) SELECT #{userCouponId}, #{userId}, COUPON_ID, #{orderId}, NOW(), #{discountAmt} FROM USER_COUPON WHERE USER_COUPON_ID = #{userCouponId}
mapper.select: SELECT OI.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, OI.OPTION_ID AS optionId, OI.QUANTITY AS quantity, OI.START_DATE AS startDate, OI.END_DATE AS endDate, O.ORDER_TYPE AS orderType FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
